answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade, and slash that stake when peers prove it spawned fake identities. A newcomer starts through a narrow inlet of trust: it may only transact via an established sponsor, and its transaction graph is public, so duplicated behavior across identities is detectable. Like a lotus that opens only once its roots are verified, an identity earns full trading rights after a history of honest, staked transactions. Spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the lockup.
